kp6:1.2:
antaḷikkhe → yānīha bhūtāni samāgatāni
bhūmyāni vā yāni vā antarīkṣe
sarvāṇi vā āttamanāti bhūtvā
śrūṇvantu svasatyayanaṃ jinena bhāṣitam (mahāvastu)
kp6:3.1:
vā → imasmiṃ loke parasmiṃ vā puna:
savēṣu vā yadātanaṃ praṇitam
na tatsamaṃ asati tathāgatena
devātidevena narottamena
idampi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ
etena satyena susvasti hotu (mahāvastu)
kp6:5.1:
suciṃ → yambuddhaśreṣṭho parivarṇayet śuciṃ
yamāhu ānantarikaṃ samādhiṃ
samādhino tasya samo na vidyāte
idampi dhamē ratanaṃ praṇītaṃ
etena satyena susvasti hotu. (mahāvastu)
kp6:6.6:
hotu → ye pudgalā aṣṭa sadā praśastā
catvāri etāni yugāni honti
te dakṣīṇeyā sugatena uktā
eteṣu dinnāni mahatphalāni
idampi saṅghe ratnaṃ praṇitaṃ
etena ............... (mahāvastu)
kp6:7.6:
hotu → ye yuktayogī manasā suchandasā
ṇaiṣakāmayino gotamaśāsanasmin
te prāptiprāptā amātaṃ ‘vagāhya
vimuktavittā nirvṛtiṃ bhuṃjamānāඃ
idampi saṃghe ................ (mahāvastu)
kp6:8.6:
hotu → yathendrakīlo pṛthiviśrito syā-
cavaturhi vātehi asamprakampī
tathopamaṃ satpuruṣaṃ vademi
yo āryasatyāni sudeśitāni
gambhīraaṭāni avetya paśyati
idampi.................... (mahāvastu)
kp6:9.6:
hotu → ye āryasatyāni vibhāvayanti
gambhīraprajñena sudeśitāni
kiñcāpi te honti bhāśaṃ pramattā
na te bhavānaṣṭa upādiyanti
idampi saṅghe.............. (mahāvastu)
kp6:11.4:
hotu → sahaiva yasya darśanasampadāya.
trayosya dharmā jahitā bhavanti
satkāyadṛṣṭiṃ vicikitsitaṃ ca
śīlavrataṃ vāpi yadasti kiñvīt
idampi saṅghe............ (mahāvastu)
kp6:12.6:
hotu → kiñcāpi śaikṣo prakaroti pāpaṃ
kāyena vācā atha cetasāpi
abhavyo so tasya niguhanāya
abhavyatā dṛṣṭipatheṣu uktā
idampi saṅghe............ (mahāvastu)
kp6:13.6:
hotu → vane pragūlamā yatha puṣpitāgrā
grīsmāṇamāse prathame caitrasmin
vāteritā te surabhiṃ pravānti
evaṃvidhā dhyāyino buddhaputrāඃ
śīlenupetā surabhiṃ pravānti
idampi saṅghe............. (mahāvastu)
kp6:15.6:
hotu → kṣīṇaṃ purāṇaṃ navo nāsti saṃcayo
vimuktavittā āyatike bhavasmin 
te kṣīṇabījā avirūḍhidharmā
nirvānti dhīrā yathā tailadīpāඃ
idampi saṅghe ratanaṃ praṇītaṃ
etena saccena susvasti hotu (mahāvastu)
kp6:16.4:
hotu → vipaśyismiṃ viścabhuvikrakucchande 
bhāmakanakamunismiṃ kāśyape 
mahāyaśe śākyamunismi gautame 
eteṣu buddheṣu mahardhikeṣu 
yā devatā satti abhiprasannā 
vāḍhampi tā rakṣantu ca karontu 

svasatyayanaṃ mānuṣiyā prajāye
yo dharmacakraṃ ahibhūya lokaṃ
pravartayati sarvabhūtānukampī
etādāśaṃ devamanuṣyaśreṣṭhaṃ
buddhaṃ namasyāma susvasti hotu.
dharmaṃ namasyāma susvasti hotu. 
saṅghaṃ namasyāma susvasti hotu.
